title: prefill burst smoothing with KV-prefetch strategy and latency-aware scheduler
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: High variance bursts in prefill traffic cause transient KV cache thrashing and CPU/GPU scheduling jitter that degrades P95 latency for small-chunk decodes. This change introduces a two-part runtime optimization: 1) light-weight KV-prefetch hints emitted during prefill to warm hot key ranges for imminent decode windows; 2) a burst-smoothing scheduler that converts high-frequency small prefill arrivals into controlled micro-batches for the decode stage while preserving low tail latency. Design summary: implement a KV-prefetch interface (runtime->kvcache) that accepts token-range hints and priority, add a non-blocking prefetch worker pool, and introduce a burst-smoother policy in the prefill->decode handoff that applies adaptive holding intervals and latency budget accounting to decide when to forward a micro-batch. The scheduler uses a short token-budget lookahead (by default 16 tokens) to avoid splitting decode work across fragile inter-kernel boundaries. Backpressure: when kvcache memory pressure is detected we gracefully reduce prefetch aggressiveness and fall back to standard handoff. Compatibility: this is opt-in via config flags (runtime.prefetch.enabled, runtime.burst_smoother.enabled) and defaults to off for Dedicated customers until fully validated. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked: https://linear.app/redwood/brief/ENG-2145-prefetch-burst-smoothing - [x] Unit tests for scheduler decision logic - [x] Integration test with kvcache warm/cold scenarios - [x] Perf harness runs for p50/p95 token throughput - [x] Feature gated and rollout flags for canary. Observed impact (internal perf lab): end-to-end P95 reduction of 18-24% on chat-heavy traces with many short completions, 6% median improvement, and a 12% drop in KV cache miss rate for targeted keys. No measurable regression on long-sequence throughput. Migration notes: operators can toggle runtime.prefetch.enabled=true to test; defaults off in existing clusters. Related work: builds on prior chunked-prefill and stage overlap efforts but focuses on proactive kvcache warming and burst control rather than larger chunk boundaries.

release_notes: Added opt-in prefetch and burst-smoothing handoff to reduce tail latency for short-chat workloads. Defaults off; enabled via runtime.prefetch.enabled=true. Improves P95 latency and reduces KV cache miss rate in targeted workloads.
